security_privacy_cost_impact: Closes an integrity gap in the test suite: run with a caller's GIT_* (as from a pre-commit hook), test-kits/branch-scope.test.mjs could rewrite the caller's index or write into another repository. No credential, secret, personal data, provider call or dependency change; ci.yml and every script CI runs are unchanged.
compatibility_impact: No contract changes. The file's run time grows by about 20 s (three nested reruns, concurrently).
known_limitations: Only this package's file is fixed. test-kits/ci-guard-behaviour.test.mjs and test-kits/handoff-conformance.test.mjs, which A1-292-2 also names, are not changed here; A1's "better still" (one shared helper and a guard over every spawnSync('git' in test-kits/) is not done.

The pin is behavioural: it reruns the file under three redirections. A new spawn site added later without withoutCallerGit is caught only if it touches git in a way those three redirections reach; no static check over spawn calls is added.
Git configuration outside the environment (the user's global or system config) still reaches the scratch repositories, as before; the scratch repositories set their own user and commit.gpgsign.
